name: skeleton
description: a Skeleton warrior, an animated skeleton with ivory-cream bones, a skull with glowing turquoise eye sockets, a ragged brown cloth loincloth, a notched bronze-and-steel sword with an orange-brown blade in his RIGHT hand and a round brown wooden shield with an orange rim and a rusty boss on his LEFT arm
hands: the sword stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the sword is lifted beside the head with its tip pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the sword hand behind the head and the sword hanging back and down behind the shoulders to the left, shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the sword arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the sword is level, its tip pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: sword arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the sword's tip striking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the sword carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the ragged loincloth trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the sword comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, the jaw snapping open, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (sword arm thrown up and out to the left, shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the sword dipping, shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, sword arm flung up, shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the sword lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the sword's tip resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the sword slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the sword lies on the ground at the lower-right; the shield lies flat beside him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the glow in the eye sockets gone dark, sword and shield on the ground beside him
